notes.title: Challenge Levels Update
notes.content:
[h3]The 4 new Challenge Levels are now available![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/01d2151d75c27097f83f1edfbfc99d74c9025043.png[/img]
The S-Rank paths in these levels are designed to incorporate some of the tricks that speedrunners have discovered since the release of the game. Check out some of the awesome runs being posted to the [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Unless]Speedrun.com page[/url] if you want to see some of these techniques in action!

All new Challenge level gates, marked with the golden leaf icon in the title, will become accessible in Amethyst Ascent Hub World when you have [b]gathered all the leaves in the main game.[/b]

We added a special pop-up prompt to warp you directly to the first Challenge Level once you gather all other leaves, but just in case you dismiss the prompt;

[h1]Using the Level select screen to access the levels:[/h1]
[list]  
	[*][b]Continue[/b] a file where you have [b]collected every other Golden Leaf[/b]
	[*]Open the [b]Pause Menu[/b]
	[*]Open the [b]Level Select[/b]  
	[*]Click the "[b]W1[/b]" tab
	[*]Select [b]Level 1-2[/b]
	[*]Exit Level 1-2, Challenge Level 1 is just below it in the W1 map!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/1b5ebdd10890dbcc7a17508a0fb3025feb26afb0.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the additional Challenge Levels! Please share your thoughts on [url=http://discord.gg/tNUWqyk]our Discord[/url].

Thanks again for your interest in [i]Unless[/i]!

[spoiler]Can you find the hidden Crewmate in the background art of the new levels?[/spoiler]

notes.title: Open beta-testing of Challenge Levels
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Gabriel here.

Having completed the first round of play-tests for the new Challenge Levels, we now consider them ready for an "open-beta" round of feedback! Check the following post for instructions:  

[h1]How to Access the New Levels[/h1]  
[list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/c4f938bddb2ef2d2399293bbc77466fe94d60bd1.png[/img]
    [*]Right-Click [i]Unless[/i] in your Steam Library and select [b]Properties[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/520f9f84279d1fac2af3d207dbe5ebe44a2bbfab.png[/img]
    [*]On the left side, select [b]Betas[/b]  
    [*]Enter the code:  
    [code]4bonuslevels[/code]  
    [*]Click "[b]Check Code[/b]"  
    [*]If you have typed the code correctly, you'll see a blue button appear that says "Opt into: bonus-levels - 4 New Levels!"  
    [*]Click "[b]Opt into: bonus-levels - 4 New Levels[/b]!", then you can close the Properties  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/19b634f75fbbb03b3085443d293b5063e1bf3549.png[/img]
    [*]If done correctly, you'll now see "Unless [bonus-levels]" in your Steam Library and text that says "Selected version bonus-levels" next to the green PLAY button  
    [*]Select [b]PLAY[/b] to begin  
[/list]  

[h1]Once You Are In-Game[/h1]  

[list]  
    [*]Select [b]Continue[/b]  
    [*]Open the [b]Pause Menu[/b]  
    [*]Open the [b]Level Select[/b]  
    [*]Click the new tab "[b]Bonus[/b]" at the top-right  
    [*]The 4 Challenge Levels can be opened from this menu  
[/list]  

The leaderboards are temporarily active, so you can compare your times against the scores of the dev-team and other play-testers, but keep in mind they might get reset if the levels are changed.  

Also, please note that the new levels are not yet decorated while we continue to collect feedback. Please share your thoughts in the #unless-beta-testing channel of [url=http://discord.gg/tNUWqyk]our Discord[/url].

It would be [i]extra-helpful[/i] to record your very first attempt of each level and share it, if possible. The new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/gamerecording]Steam Game Recording[/url] feature makes this rather easy to do!  

Thanks again for your interest in [i]Unless[/i]! I hope to share the new levels with you all soon!

notes.title: New Levels Incoming for Unless!
notes.content:
As a big thanks to everyone who has supported the game so far, we're excited to announce that we're adding [b]4 brand-new levels[/b] to the first World of Unless! These levels will be [b]exclusive to the full version of the game[/b]—they won’t be available in the demo.  

We’re inviting players to help us [b]test these new levels[/b] before release! Here’s how:  

[list]  
    [*][b]Alpha Test[/b] – First, we’ll run a [b]closed alpha[/b] for those who want an early look. Keep in mind these levels will be [b]undecorated[/b], since their layout may change over the course of testing.  
    [*][b]Public Beta[/b] – After the alpha, we’ll open up a [b]public beta[/b] so more players can jump in and try them out.  
[/list]  

[h3]Want to join the Alpha?[/h3]
If you haven't already, please consider joining the [url=https://discord.gg/eBvb6buytU]Bellwood Studios Discord server[/url].
Get the [b]Unless-tester[/b] role from the #role-pick channel of our Discord and make sure your DMs are open. We'll reach out to small batches of players at a time. Keep in mind, we're looking for casual players as well as speedrunners!  

Your feedback will help us fine-tune these levels before they officially launch. Thanks for being part of this journey with us, and see you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Unless 1.0 Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Gabriel here! Today, we’re proud to announce the 1.0 Release of “[i]Unless[/i]”!
As you may or may not know, I had two main goals when designing the levels of Unless;
- [b]Create levels that are fun; not frustrating[/b]. This meant including frequent checkpoints to reduce the amount of content that you would have to repeat if you died, but also implementing a huge amount of Accessibility Features such as the Co-op Assist mode.
- [b]Create levels that are challenging to speedrun[/b]. I love watching skilled players speedrun Kaizo Mario levels, so while I ensured the game would be accessible to players of all ages and skill levels, I specifically designed every stage to push players to their limits when it came to playing them quickly. With the help of our talented play-testers, we’ve set “S-Rank” times for each level that will require a bit of puzzle-solving to figure out the optimal route, and a fair amount of mastery to actually execute. I’d say the game really “comes to life” when you pursue these goal times, so please give it your best try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/a4006947b069b13eaba10e655a3bb0b36f36ecaa.gif[/img]

To highlight everyone’s accomplishments, we’ve got Leaderboards for every Individual Level, each of the 4 Worlds in the game, and “Full Game” categories so you can test your mastery against players from across the world. Plus, there are “All Berries” variants of each Leaderboard!
We’d like to encourage players to submit recordings of their runs to [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Unless]our official Speedrun.com site[/url], on r/speedrun or other appropriate subReddits, and on the [url=http://discord.gg/tNUWqyk]Bellwood Studios Discord[/url] where you can also chat with fellow players and look forward to some game-key give-aways and “speedrun bounties” in the coming weeks.

We’re also excited to announce a brand new feature; [b]Shuffle Mode[/b]! This mode takes the carefully crafted levels of Unless and randomizes the links between every level gate in the game. It also shuffles the position of Golden Leaves and Crystal Berries within each level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050505/a4006947b069b13eaba10e655a3bb0b36f36ecaa.gif[/img]

You’ll find yourself hopping between Worlds, unlocking Berry Gates, and playing levels backwards as you try to gather all the Golden Leaves. You can configure how many levels are included, as well as a few other settings, then share seeds so you can race a friend! We’re looking forward to seeing players attempt the daunting “fully randomized” mix of every level in the game.
This mode is unlocked when you complete the base game, and also has a [b]Daily Challenge[/b] that you can attempt [i]only once[/i] to try and place on the daily Leaderboard. You’ll need skill, but also a fair bit of luck to succeed in Shuffle Mode, so I hope everyone feels like they’ve got a shot at placing #1!

We’ll be doing our best to support the game post-launch with some extra polish and bug fixing. Please reach out to us on [url=http://discord.gg/tNUWqyk]our Discord[/url] if you’ve spotted something awry, and we’ll try to get a fix implemented ASAP. Please note that localization remains an ongoing community effort, which you can contribute to via our CrowdIn project page: [url=https://crowdin.com/project/unless]https://crowdin.com/project/unless[/url]

The release of “[i]Unless[/i]” is the culmination of many years of effort (the initial prototype is from way-back in 2018!) I hope you’ll appreciate all the effort and polish that has gone into the game from our many talented team members.

Thank you, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Unless Demo Available Now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.

Unless Demo Is Available Now :D

We would like to take this opportunity with the launching of the demo for Unless to thank those who have been playtesting the game, getting in those record times and helping us find any bugs that cropped up. Thank You!

To set some expectations, Unless is not a story rich game nor does it have any “gimmicks”. The goal of Unless is pure platforming, it’s just you, the tight level design and the clock. 
The aim is to provide the thrill and adrenaline of honing your skill and finding the quickest path through each level and world. We hope the demo will demonstrate this addictive gameplay. And we hope you will enjoy it as much as we have competing with each other on the leaderboards. 

Whilst the game is all about skill and precision, there are a slew of accessibility options available and you can play the game at your own pace in the non speedrunning mode. 

As a closing note, don’t hesitate to join our Discord, share your runs and if you encounter any issues feel free to chat with us there. 

Cheers & see you all on the Leaderboards ;)
